title: avena bromoides var. parlatorei
intro: Avena bromoides var. parlatorei, commonly known as oat grass, is a type of grass belonging to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and stress, improving sleep quality, and alleviating symptoms of anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of oat grass include sedative, anxiolytic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as avenacosides, avenanthramides, and other polyphenolic compounds. The bioactive constituents of oat grass may also contribute to its potential to improve cardiovascular health and reduce oxidative stress.
